body.name: Exact deletion and action-loss components
body.construction:
\[
D_{n,m}(\beta)
=d_{T_n^{\mathrm{full}}}(\beta)
-\left(\frac Nn\right)^2
E_{S_m}d_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}(\beta),
\]
\[
L_{n,m}(\delta_m,\beta)
=\left(\frac Nn\right)^2
E\!\left[
V_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}(\delta_m,\beta)
-V_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}
\{G_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}(\beta),\beta\}
\right].
\]
The second quantity is an action-loss contrast; no finite-sample nonnegativity is included in its definition.
